info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Management API
info.description: The Loan Management API facilitates the efficient handling of loan records within the system. Using this API, users can permanently remove a loan by specifying its unique identifier, streamlining the loan lifecycle management. This is particularly useful for financial institutions and service providers who need to maintain accurate and up-to-date loan records. Typical consumers of this API include loan officers and automated systems responsible for maintaining loan portfolios.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a loan identified by its unique ID. Use this operation to permanently remove the loan from the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete a specific loan identified by LOAN-500045. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions before proceeding with the deletion.

204.description: Successfully deleted the requested loan resource.

DeleteLoanByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the payload for the DELETE request to the operations of the loan identifier 500045.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes the Bearer authentication method, where the client must include a JSON Web Token (JWT) in the Authorization header of requests. The token should be prefixed with 'Bearer ' to indicate the use of bearer tokens for authentication.
